ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low white-to-black ratio; approximately 8% high-intensity pixels (white) concentrated at the notch and tip regions against 92% low-intensity (dark grey/black) background pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant vertical high-intensity white streak located at the x-axis center (median notch). Dispersed, low-diameter white pixel clusters (stippling) distributed across both ventral lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 48 degrees; depth corresponds to roughly 12% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire continuous trailing boundary; peaks exhibit a 5-15 pixel amplitude from the baseline curve, particularly prominent on the proximal side of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex-upward curvature originating from the fluke base, transitioning to a sharp distal taper at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular pixel clusters detected at the distal tips of both lobes and scattered across the left lobe surface, indicating localized surface irregularities.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, multi-directional linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible on the left lobe, primarily oriented at diagonal angles to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant textural irregularity and calcified high-intensity massing at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced single vertical white pigmentation band originating at the apex of the median notch.
